items.summary: The US treasury sold $42 billion of 10 year notes: High yield: 5.02% WI level at the time of the auction: 5.01% Tail: +1.0 basis point vs the average of −0.6 basis points Bid to cover: 2.46X vs the average of 2.60X Directs: 29.0% vs the average of 15.9% Indirects: 61.2% vs average of 76.65% Dealers: 9.8% vs the average of 7.45% Auction grade: D+ The auction was a little soft. The high yield came in 1.0 basis point above the WI level, compared with an average stop-through of 0.6 basis points. Bid to cover fell to 2.46X versus the average of 2.60X, and dealers were left with a larger share than usual. Direct bidders were the bright spot, taking 29.0% versus the average of 15.9%, but that was outweighed by the tail, the softer bid to cover and the higher dealer takedown. This article was written by Greg Michalowski at investinglive.com.

Their findings could help astronomers forecast these phenomena more accurately and coordinate timely observations.

Why it matters: The Consumer Price Index shows that even as gasoline prices steadied, inflation pressures elsewhere remained stubborn. By the numbers: CPI rose 0.4% last month, slowing from the 0.6% increase in September. Gasoline prices gained 1% in October, a sharp slowdown from the 9.1% surge in September, the Labor Department said. Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, advanced 0.3% for the third straight month, with higher prices for recreation, medical care, car insurance and airline fares contributing to the increase. My mum was a professional dancer and always encouraged me to perform. Given that I have zero rhythm, comedy was my other option. Since Bell placed third in the stage, and Denny Hamlin sixth, Larson's P4 was enough for him to clinch the title mid-race. He becomes just the 11th driver in NASCAR Cup Series history to win three championships, and the first to win back-to-back Cup titles since the end of Jimmie Johnson's historic five-year run in 2010.

Kyle Larson is a three-time NASCAR Cup Series champion. From a 51-race winless streak to a remarkable Chase turnaround, here's how the Hendrick Motorsports driver secured another title. Here's everything to know about the DLS method and all the ways by which scores are calculated under the rain check. DLS calculates targets using resources, meaning overs remaining and wickets in hand together. The VJD method is the only serious modern rival, and it is used in Indian domestic cricket. Earlier systems failed because they ignored wickets, most notoriously at the 1992 World Cup. The Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method is the system cricket uses to reset a target when rain or any other interruption shortens a limited-overs match. It was devised by two English statisticians, Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis, introduced in 1997 and adopted by the ICC two years later.

When a user chooses the “Yes, and don’t ask again” option to approve running a command, that choice gets stored as part of a rule in the local “.claude/settings.local.json” file on the user’s computer. In reality, they could've run any play to burn the clock, but McVay put the ball in the hands of Nacua, who had already racked up 15 touches before that carry. Texas A&M product Braden Mann delivered an 86-yard punt and a negative-2-yard punt in the same game for the Philadelphia Eagles. A surprising discovery suggests that some early signs of Alzheimer’s disease may begin outside the brain. Using miniature laboratory systems made from human cells, scientists found that genetic mutations associated with inherited Alzheimer’s can disrupt nerve-to-muscle connections without any involvement from the brain or spinal cord. This could help explain why some patients experience changes in balance, walking, and coordination long before memory problems develop. Alzheimer's disease is best known for its effects on memory and thinking, but new research suggests that some symptoms may develop in a surprising place: outside the brain.

Goaltender Pekka Rinne, the Nashville Predators' all-time leader in wins, was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame on Nov. 9. Pekka Rinne was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame on Nov. 9, joining the Class of 2026 that includes Patrice Bergeron, Carey Price, Cindy Curley, Keith Tkachuk and Brian Burke. "I'm humbled to be standing here amongst all my heroes," Rinne said from the stage at Brookfield Place in Toronto. "I'd be lying if I said I saw this coming." Rinne is the Predators' all-time leader in wins (369), shutouts (60), saves (17,627) and playoff wins (45). He won the Vezina Trophy as the league's top goaltender in 2018 and the King Clancy Memorial Trophy in 2021.

Letter: Ground-source and air-source heat pumps are extremely efficient machines, writes, David Reynolds I read Mary Massey’s letter ( 2 November ) with some surprise. She said that her heat pump needs an annual service and that this year it cost about £350. My ground-source heat pump has been heating my house for 18 years and it does not need or get an annual service. A heat pump is essentially a big refrigerator working in reverse, and how often do you have your fridge serviced? That is another benefit of heat pumps. In a country of severe water scarcity, the Abu Obeida mosque in Deir Alla captures ablution wastewater before it reaches the sewers to use for irrigation T he Abu Obeida mosque in Deir Alla, Balqa, to the west of Amman, stands in one of the hottest and most arid stretches of the Jordan valley. Yet an oasis of trees and flowerbeds surrounds it, improbably green against a landscape of bare ochre hills, watered by drip irrigation lines that run along the ground between the roots. The water does not come from the municipal network, but from the taps where worshippers wash their hands, faces and feet before prayer.

American, Ukrainian and Russian representatives gathered in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday for their latest round of trilateral peace talks. LONDON -- American, Ukrainian and Russian representatives gathered in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday for their latest round of trilateral peace talks, with President Donald Trump's administration seeking a diplomatic breakthrough after 1,721 days of Moscow's full-scale invasion of its neighbor. Trump -- who came to office vowing to end the war within 24 hours -- has thus far been unable to force a breakthrough. His chief negotiating envoys, Steve Witkoff and Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, are leading the U.S. delegation in Abu Dhabi this week.

BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains how the Uefa Nations League works. The competition began in 2018, and the format sees each nation compete across four different divisions. Each side competes for promotion and relegation in every campaign, with the best-performing nations in the top league going on to reach the play-offs at the end of each campaign. The best-performing nations in each Nations League campaign can also strengthen their chances of qualifying for World Cups and European Championships, but cannot directly qualify for major tournaments through the Nations League alone.

Ukraine competes with Russia and data centers for China’s optical fiber supply. Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister. Israel's new parliament will be sworn in on Tuesday, as opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot seeks to oust caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The former army chief was tasked with forming a government by the president, after he received the backing of 67 members of the 120-seat Knesset, compared to 46 for Netanyahu. He has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible two-week extension.

Bucking recent trends, fossil fuel emissions look to be down 0.4 percent. Annual greenhouse gas emissions are much less variable, having increased fairly steadily, but many complicating factors can still muddy the picture. Sometimes those factors conspire to throw a year off the trend. It looks like 2026 will be one of those years. A new analysis led by Corinne Le Quéré at the University of East Anglia estimates that fossil fuel emissions have fallen about 0.4 percent from last year. This probably isn’t a peak that symbolizes heartening progress on climate change, though; the researchers think it’s a short-term dip driven by the war in Iran and its effect on oil prices.

Adam Bazalgette's new drill uses a simple visual trick to stop the club from going too far inside. Stop the slice and hit solid drives today. The setup requires a specific grip change to feel the shaft against the back of the fingers. A golfer flattens the trail hand and places it in front of the shaft so the palm lines up with the clubface. This position stops the player from grabbing the club and whipping it inside too early. The drill works by forcing the arms and body to stay connected rather than letting the hands take over the movement.

The US Food and Drug Administration says Ozempic, Wegovy, and other weight-loss drugs must have labels about the condition, known as NAION. The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) told makers of popular weight-loss GLP-1 drugs that they must add warning labels about a rare eye condition that can cause sudden blindness. Manufacturers of Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound must warn about nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION). The disorder happens when vessels supplying blood to the optic nerves become blocked, depriving the nerves of oxygen.
